operating_notes.text: B2C revenue share was about 75% in FY26.
Tier 3+ geographies contributed close to 39% of revenues.
Revenue per patient rose to ₹968 in Q1FY27 from ₹880 a year earlier, with CGHS/ECHS price revision contributing 2-3% at company level.
Swasthfit is 27% of revenue and grew about 20% in Q1FY27, in line with overall revenue, so its share was unchanged.
Rural outreach programme is active in 7 states and tested more than 1,10,000 patients in Q1FY27; it is a separate affordable package, not Swasthfit.
